title: The Four-World Joint Race Kicks Off!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the Landosol Stakes.
A large crowd had gathered in front of the castle gates of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルステークスからしばらくして──
ランドソルの城門前には大勢の人が集まっていた。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Everyoneeee! Heyas☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさーん！
オイッスー☆

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Heyas!!
text_block_list.orig_text: オイッスー！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi, Umapyoi☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
うまぴょい、
うまぴょい☆

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi, Umapyoiii!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うまぴょい、
うまぴょーい！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
...And with that!
We're officially kicking off the Four-World Joint Princess Cup☆!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……という訳で！
『四世界合同プリンセス杯』を
開催いたしまーす☆

text_block_list.name: People
text_block_list.text: WOAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: わああああーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa, everyone's really fired up, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──な、
なんや
えらい盛り上がりやねぇ？

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes are positively shining with excitement.
However, what exactly is this "Four-World Joint Princess Cup"...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に、
みなさん目を輝かせていらして。
ですが、
『四世界合同プリンセス杯』
とは一体……？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text:
It's a race that was organized by Pecorine and the other Princesses.
Ever since you arrived in this world and everything that's happened since...
Your exploits have become so famous that practically everyone knows about you, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌさんたち、
プリンセスが企画したレースなの。
あなたたちがこの世界にやってきて、
いろいろあって──
今では
その活躍を知らない人はいないくらい
話題になってるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Just so.
I myself have seen children pretending to race after being inspired by the "Umamusume", as well as young people taking up running themselves.
Seeing this, I thought it would be wonderful if everyone could enjoy running even more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
ウマ娘にあこがれたお子さまがたが
レースごっこをしたり
若い方が触発されて走ったりと、
最近よくお見かけいたします。
でしたら、
もっともっと楽しく走っていただきたいと──

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why we decided to hold this event☆
We want everyone to run to their hearts' content and enjoy everything Astrum and the Underworlds have to offer!
I'm sure it'll be a hundred times more fun if we all run together☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
──と思ったので、
決めました☆　
みんなでたくさん走って、
このアストルムや裏世界を丸ごと楽しんでもらいたいって！
みんなで走れば、
百倍楽しめちゃうはずです☆

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Mind you, if it were just a straight-up footrace, the inhabitants of LoA wouldn't stand a chance...
That's why we've prepared some obstacles this time.
It'll be a different kind of fun from a race that's just about speed, don't you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
つっても、
ただ走るだけなら、
LoAの住人は勝ち目がない……
だ
からね、
今回は障害物も用意してあるわ。
速さを競うレースとは
また違った楽しみ方ができるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That sounds like so much fun! Places I've never been, sights I've never seen...
And getting to race together with everyone?
That sounds absolutely wonderful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！　
とっても楽しそうね！
知らない場所、
知らない景色。
みんなで走れるなんて
そんなのとっても素敵だわ！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course, obstacles or not, I won't be holding back.
I'll be going all out for the win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
障害物があろうがなかろうが、
手加減はなしよ。
全力で勝ちにいくわ！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Rightly so, Ai-san.
Us two are of the same mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうやな、
アイさん。
うちらも参加させてもらいましょ。

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I, too, shall run with all my might!
I believe this world's magnificent natural environment will help me grow stronger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
全力で走ります！
この世界の大いなる自然が、
私を鍛えてくださると信じて！

text_block_list.text: I won't be outdone either, I say!
text_block_list.orig_text: おいどんも負けないでゴワス！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: This voice... I knew it! Golshi-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この声は……
……やっぱり、
ゴルシさん！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo, girls! I'm gonna join in the race too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようオマエら！　
アタシも出場するぜ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shadow Golshi-chan may have lost, but the regular Golshi-chan isn't gonna lose, no wayyy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シャドウゴルシちゃんは負けちゃったけどぉ、
通常ゴルシちゃんは負けないんだからぁ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe even Golshi-san is entering...!
Hehehe! Now I'm even more fired up♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴルシさんも参加するなんて……！
ふふふっ、
ますますやる気が出てきちゃったわ♪

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
All right, then! Let's get this show on the road!
The Four-World Joint Princess Cup is officially underway☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
さっそく！
『四世界合同プリンセス杯』
開幕ですよ～っ☆
